lines.text: Christ is the mediator of a new covenant so that those who are called may receive the promised eternal inheritance.
A will takes effect only when the one who made it has died, so even the first covenant required blood.
Moses sprinkled the doorposts and all the people with the blood of calves and goats.
Christ entered the tabernacle to appear for us before God, not to offer Himself again and again.
Christ was offered once to bear the sins of many and will appear again to save those awaiting Him.
